arguments.analyst: Observed brightness clusters near 3.5-3.87 for several distinct edits (O1, O2, O3, O6, O8, O9), while some mutants are dim (O4, O5). Menu candidates with conservative single/double edits score ~3.5.
arguments.hypothesis: Conservative single-residue or low-impact double substitutions near the observed bright cluster (e.g. K41R-like, E6K, K79E:N105Y) will retain high fluorescence, while multi-charge substitutions in buried regions reduce it.

decision.analyst: Observed brightness clusters near 3.5-3.87 for several distinct edits (O1, O2, O3, O6, O8, O9), while some mutants are dim (O4, O5). Menu candidates with conservative single/double edits score ~3.5.
decision.hypothesis: Conservative single-residue or low-impact double substitutions near the observed bright cluster (e.g. K41R-like, E6K, K79E:N105Y) will retain high fluorescence, while multi-charge substitutions in buried regions reduce it.
decision.critic: Top estimates cluster ~3.56-3.63 with low uncertainty, but C02's 2.29 shows multi-edits can collapse; predictions unverified.
